subject: Volume discount tiers for hosted API - OrbitFin
messages:
From: Nicolas Park <n.park@orbitfin.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ava Gomez <ava.gomez@orbitfin.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Volume pricing request - hosted API

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — nice walkthrough of the routing/fallback features. We're sizing for a Q3 launch and need a clearer sense of baseline hosted API pricing for planning. Current estimate: ~5B tokens/month in steady-state with a 10B token burst window for campaigns.

Can you share: 
- Baseline per-token price for the hosted API (non-committed) for your recommended model class (standard vs. high-throughput).
- Volume tier discounts and the ramp schedule (monthly vs. annual commit).
- Any minimum commitment thresholds for reserved pricing and the process to scale up quickly during a campaign.

Attached is a small spreadsheet that maps our expected token volumes by month. If there's a quick one-pager rate card you can send that would be perfect.

Goal: produce a cost estimate and decide whether to pursue a committed capacity pilot.

Thanks,
Nicolas
VP Product, OrbitFin

Attachment: 2026-02-20-OrbitFin-rate-request.pdf (spreadsheet stub)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Nicolas Park <n.park@orbitfin.com>
Cc: Ava Gomez <ava.gomez@orbitfin.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Volume pricing request - hosted API

Hi Nicolas — great to hear from you and thanks for the MVE spreadsheet. 

Short answer: we can definitely support your scale and offer stepped discounts with either monthly or annual commitments. I'll summarize a practical starting point below and attach a short spreadsheet with sample math. Monica (our Sales Ops lead) is cc'd to help with formal pricing and contract framing.

Quick baseline (public hosted, non-committed):
- Standard model class: $0.00015 per token (generation + prompt aggregated)
- High-throughput optimized model: $0.00011 per token

Volume discount framework (examples, negotiable):
- 0 - 1B tokens: baseline price
- 1B - 5B: 10% off baseline
- 5B - 15B: 18% off baseline
- 15B+: 27% off baseline

Commit options:
- Monthly committed tiers (flexible, short notice scaling +10% over commit for bursts)
- Annual committed contract: deeper discounts (additional 6-10% off tier rates depending on size and term) and SLA uplift.

Minimum committed threshold for reserved pricing: 1B tokens/month or equivalent annualized commit. Scaling process: we provision dedicated capacity pools and can add burst capacity within 24–72 hours depending on region and GPU availability.

I've attached a sample proposal that runs your 5B steady / 10B burst scenario across both model classes and committed vs. non-committed economics. Can we schedule 30 minutes on Monday to walk through numbers?

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: 2026-02-22-Redwood-proposal-v1.xlsx (pricing worksheet stub)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Volume pricing request - hosted API

Rishi / Marcus — quick internal note before we present:

1) For OrbitFin's 5B steady state / 10B burst ask, recommend we:
   - Propose high-throughput model as default (better economics)
   - Offer a 12-month commit with an initial 20% off baseline for the 5B bracket, and 25% off for the 10B burst buckets if they commit to a defined burst window schedule (campaign cadence).
2) Add a short-term onboarding credit (one-time) to offset migration/engineering work — e.g., $25k credit applied to first invoice.
3) Clarify SLA: 99.9% regional availability + priority capacity during campaign windows (we'll need to reserve burst pools).

Pricing mechanics notes (for Marcus to confirm numbers):
- If baseline high-throughput is $0.00011/token, 20% off -> $0.000088/token for committed 5B tier.
- For annualized billing with pre-pay, we can push another 6% which brings to ~$0.000083/token.
- Need margin check on quantized models and if they require Private deployment (likely not for OrbitFin).

Marcus — can you run a quick margin + capacity feasibility check and confirm we can guarantee burst pools for their target windows? Also confirm any required lead time for extra capacity.

Thanks,
Monica
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nicolas Park <n.park@orbitfin.com>, Ava Gomez <ava.gomez@orbitfin.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Volume pricing request - hosted API

Hi team and Nicolas — quick update on capacity and feasibility.

We can support the proposed approach. Notes: 
- Capacity: for the proposed 10B burst window we recommend reserving a dedicated burst pool in us-west and us-east; lead time to guarantee the pool is 7 business days (we can expedite to 48 hours with an upfront burst reservation).
- Margins: at $0.000088/token (committed 5B tier) our gross margin is healthy given batching and KV caching assumptions. Pre-pay annual increases margin by ~4-6% on top.
- Implementation: We'll set a campaign runbook (reserved pool start/stop, traffic shaping rules) and include it in the SOW.

Next steps: Rishi/Monica to send a short two-page offer that lists: commit levels, effective per-token rates, campaign burst reservation terms, onboarding credit, and the draft SOW link. Nicolas — if that looks good we'll prepare a 12-month commitment quote and an expedited provisioning option.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Platform Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference

---
Onboarding action items (informal):
- Rishi: schedule a 30-minute review with OrbitFin (Mon 2/27 recommended)
- Monica: draft 2-page offer + SOW skeleton
- Marcus: prepare capacity reservation pricing for expedited 48-hr option

Best,
Marcus
